evidence.title: Jericho (2006 TV series)

evidence.title: List of Jericho episodes
evidence.text: The series is set in the fictional town of Jericho, Kansas in the aftermath of the simultaneous nuclear attacks on 23 American cities.

evidence.title: List of Jericho episodes
evidence.text: The second season focuses on the arrival of a new federal government, the imposition of a police state, and Jake Green's (Skeet Ulrich) and Robert Hawkins' (Lennie James) attempt to expose the masterminds behind the attack.

evidence.title: Jon Stone
evidence.text: Jon Stone (April 13, 1932 – March 30, 1997) was an American award-winning writer, director and producer, who was best known for being an original crew member on "Sesame Street" and is credited with helping develop characters such as Cookie Monster, Oscar the Grouch and Big Bird.

evidence.title: Jon Stone
evidence.text: Stone won 18 television Emmy Awards Many regard him as one of the best children's television writers.

evidence.title: Television Writers Vault
evidence.text: The Television Writers Vault is an online marketplace within the television industry used for scouting and selling original TV formats, concepts, and intellectual properties to produce as new television shows.

evidence.title: Television Writers Vault
evidence.text: It is the first website to deliver new show ideas from people outside of the industry, resulting in successful productions by major networks.

evidence.title: Television Writers Vault
evidence.text: 2012 saw the global broadcast of two reality television concepts discovered from the site; "Saw Dogs" (aired on Discovery Channel, TV4 Sweden, and OLN) and "Deals From The Darkside" (aired on SyFy, A&E Australia, OLN, UKTV).

evidence.title: Television Writers Vault
evidence.text: 2014 saw the premiere of "Kim of Queens" on Lifetime TV, whose star, Kim Gravel, was discovered pitching her own concepts at the TV Writers Vault.
